Name: (Outdated) Online and Home Shopping
Author: naeldeus
Description:
i don't like the vanilla looks of the catalogues and not many furniture mods change them so i decide to do so. pretend you're ordering online! there are two versions. enjoy!

[center][color=#ffffff][url=https://ko-fi.com/naeldeus]consider buying me a coffee if you enjoy my mods and wish to support me![/url]﻿[/color][/center]

[b]features:
[/b]
[list]
[*]retextures of the furniture and wallpaper catalogues
[*]two versions, a light and dark version to match your interior
[*]this mod should work even if you already have a mod that changes your furniture
[/list]

[b]installation:
[/b]
[list]
[*]download and install the latest version of SMAPI and Content Patcher
[*]drop the content of this zip file in your Mods[i] [/i]folder
[*][u]optional:[/u] rename the pngs in the assets folder from[i] laptop_dark.png[/i] and [i]tv_dark.png[/i] to [i]laptop.png[/i] and [i]tv.png[/i] if you wish to use the dark version
[*]that’s it, enjoy!
[/list]
